create_DmlabGymEnv: create a DmlabGymEnv instance with a DeepMind Lab level, resolution, action repeat, and GPU index
run_DmlabGymEnv_reset: run reset on a DmlabGymEnv to start a new episode with a random or cached seed
run_DmlabGymEnv_step: run step on a DmlabGymEnv with an action index to advance the environment and get observations
test_DmlabGymEnv_render: test the DmlabGymEnv render method to display the current observation frame in human or rgb_array mode
review_DmlabGymEnv_fetch_write: review the DmlabGymEnv fetch and write methods that proxy level cache operations for cached PK3 files
